run_svd_lowrank: run svd_lowrank on a large sparse matrix to compute approximate singular value decomposition
run_pca_lowrank: run pca_lowrank on a centered data matrix to extract principal components and eigenvalues
run_get_approximate_basis: run get_approximate_basis to compute an orthonormal basis approximating a matrix subspace
test_svd_lowrank_with_mean: test svd_lowrank with a mean matrix M to compute SVD of A minus its mean
test_pca_lowrank_uncentered: test pca_lowrank with center=False to compute SVD on pre-centered data
